youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Burger Shot Florida Promotion Announced By Rockstar
socialHook: Rockstar Games partners with Skinny Louie for GTA 6 Burger Shot pop-ups in Florida through December 31.

sections.heading: Partnership Details
paragraphs: Rockstar Games and Skinny Louie announced a partnership to promote GTA 6, converting Skinny Louie stores into Burger Shot locations across Florida through December 31. The campaign includes smash burgers, fries, and drinks styled after Vice City, available for in-store purchase or delivery at every Skinny Louie location and the Kaseya Center.

sections.heading: Reactions and Coverage
paragraphs: Some local lawmakers oppose the deal, arguing the partnership promotes Miami as a murder capital, while others view it as harmless video game promotion. It remains unclear whether Cluckin' Bell locations will extend beyond the Kaseya Center like Burger Shot spots, and the campaign's full reach across Florida beaches and hotels is still unfolding.
